CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanAsk.fr: Mon mari a soif à force d'échanger.\nNotre puits est à sec.\pDeux bouteilles d'EAU FRAÎCHE lui\nsauveraient la journée.
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanAsk.en: My husband is thirsty from all that\ntrading. Our well went dry.\pTwo bottles of FRESH WATER would\nsave his day, dear.

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanGives.fr: Oh, merci ! Il boit comme un trou\nmaintenant.\pPrends ça, un dresseur le lui a\noffert il y a longtemps.
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanGives.en: Oh, bless you! He drinks like a\nfish now.\pTake this, it was a gift to him\nfrom a trainer long ago.

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanNo.fr: Bien sûr, bien sûr. Il se\ndébrouillera.
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanNo.en: Of course, of course. He will\nmanage.

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanOffer.fr: C'est de l'EAU FRAÎCHE ? Peux-tu\nm'en donner deux pour mon mari ?
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_OldWomanOffer.en: Is that FRESH WATER? Could you\nspare two for my husband?

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWith.fr: Mon mari aime échanger des POKéMON.\pTu collectionnes des POKéMON pour\nton POKéDEX, n'est-ce pas ?\pVoudrais-tu échanger avec lui ?
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWith.en: My husband likes trading POKéMON.\pYou're collecting POKéMON for your\nPOKéDEX, aren't you?\pWould you please trade with him?

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestAsk.fr:
Je suis une DRESSEUSE à la
retraite.\pMontre-moi un POKéMON de niveau
45 ou plus et je te donne mon
CÂBLE LINK.
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestAsk.en: I'm a retired TRAINER.\pShow me a POKéMON at level 45\nor higher and I'll give you my\nLINK CABLE.

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestDone.en: Does the LINK CABLE work well?

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestNo.fr: Aucun de tes POKéMON n'est encore\nassez fort. Entraîne-les !
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestNo.en: None of your POKéMON are strong\nenough yet. Train them!

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestNoRoom.fr: Ton SAC est plein. Fais d'abord\nde la place !
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestNoRoom.en: Your BAG is full. Make some\nroom first!

CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestOk.fr: Quel POKéMON puissant !\nPrends ce CÂBLE LINK.
CeruleanCity_House3_Text_QuestOk.en: That is a strong POKéMON!\nTake this LINK CABLE.
